summary.intent: Triage pending todos, consolidate three related ones (REQ-2 seeding cleanup, REQ-3 shared-folder SDK ownership, REQ-4 share itemName encryption) into Phase 48, and fix the web-e2e regression introduced by PR #498 (SDK self-bootstrap clobbering folderTree state) as a P0 prerequisite.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created, fully planned (6 plans, 3 waves, checker passed), and Wave 1 (REQ-1 P0 fix) was executed and verified green in CI on the 4th dispatch. The regression had three layered root causes, all fixed. Waves 2–3 (REQ-2/3/4) began executing but are not yet complete.

repo: web-e2e only auto-triggers on push to main (ci-e2e.yml); can be manually dispatched against any branch via `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` without needing `secrets: inherit`
NODE_ENV=test relaxes the IPNS resolve rate limit in app.module.ts — running local e2e under NODE_ENV=development causes 429 storms that don't occur in CI, causing false-negative local reproductions

The bin-restore-after-reload spec uses the real Web3Auth DEVNET Core Kit flow (loginViaWallet, not test-login bypass), causing ~60–90s login times and external DEVNET flakiness orthogonal to code changes

BinPage and FilesPage have identical auth guards but BinPage is uniquely vulnerable to the post-reload restore-window race because it mounts fresh on navigation (after FilesPage already survived the loading window)

loadBin's auto-repair path blind-published an empty bin with no expectedSequenceNumber — the API's upsertFolderIpns unconditionally increments and overwrites latestCid, making this destructive on any transient 404
The phase/branching_strategy in gsd-tools creates a new branch off origin/main even when on a diverged feature branch, which can orphan planning commits if not caught
CRDT-IPNS-inbox research (#2) deferred as long-horizon but noted to subsume the itemName plaintext leak (REQ-4/M1) — cross-linked in ROADMAP
pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run is the TypeORM migration command; new migrations trigger a [BLOCKING] gate in plan-phase

code.finding: Unconditional folderTree.set() in loadFolder — the REQ-1 self-bootstrap clobber point; fixed with a sequenceNumber guard
ensureFolderLoaded short-circuit and DFS child-check — must be preserved when adding the REQ-1 guard to avoid re-regressing #498
Auto-repair block that blind-published empty bin state (no expectedSequenceNumber) on a double-null resolve — destructively clobbers real bin records on transient IPNS 404s after reload

isLoading needs to include `|| (coreKitInitialized && coreKitLoggedIn && !isAuthenticated)` to close the post-reload restore-window gap where BinPage mounts while isLoading=false but isAuthenticated is transiently false
navigate('/') auth guard fires during post-reload restore window — the bounce that prevents the bin from ever rendering (root cause of the bin-restore-after-reload regression)
Catch-block navigate('/files') was incorrectly hypothesized as the bounce source — Playwright trace confirmed it never fires; the real bounce is BinPage.tsx:29
IPNS resolve throttle limits are relaxed when NODE_ENV=test for browser E2E — local reproduction must use NODE_ENV=test to match CI behavior
90s test timeout with Web3Auth DEVNET login inside beforeAll (~60–90s) leaves only ~30s for the actual assertions — external DEVNET flakiness causes login-phase failures that look like test failures

workflow: Always examine the Playwright failure artifact (trace + screenshot) before forming a root-cause hypothesis — the trace reveals the navigation timeline, browser console, and network calls; skipping this caused three wrong CI dispatches (~36 min wasted)
When a subagent dies mid-run, verify git state immediately before doing concurrent work — a zombie process can commit its own changes and wipe concurrent working-tree edits

When 1Password SSH signing wedges (failed to fill whole buffer), commit with --no-gpg-sign to avoid blocking, then re-enable and batch-resign all unsigned commits via interactive rebase before opening the PR
Local e2e reproduction requires exact CI env parity (NODE_ENV, DB name, ports) — even a single env difference (NODE_ENV=development vs test) can produce rate-limit failures that don't exist in CI
For CI-gated autonomous runs, the Playwright trace artifact is more diagnostic than log grep — it contains structured events with timestamps vs raw log lines
Decompose suspected root causes before each CI re-dispatch; three aimed hypotheses all failed because they were not grounded in trace evidence first

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged mid-autonomous-run (`failed to fill whole buffer`) requiring fallback to unsigned commits for 6 commits (fe646fd5f through aea3856de)
Three CI dispatches (each ~12–15 min) consumed before examining the Playwright trace — the trace was the definitive diagnostic and should have been the first step
Bash tool hard-blocks all .env file access (security guard), making it impossible to programmatically restore apps/api/.env after switching to CI-matching env for local reproduction

A dead subagent (a1eaf3b7d3872be94) ran 72 minutes / 392 tool calls, hit a stream-idle timeout, then its background process continued running and committed its own work (73c9f037a), overwriting the main agent's concurrent instrumentation and useAuth.ts fix
Two stream-idle timeout errors hit during the session, interrupting work mid-execution and losing partial responses
The bin-restore-after-reload spec used real Web3Auth DEVNET (not deterministic test-login), making local reproduction inherently flaky on the login step (~50% login success rate observed)
Local e2e false-negatives due to NODE_ENV=development rate limiting (429 storms) vs CI's NODE_ENV=test — caused one additional failed local run before the env mismatch was identified

GSD branching_strategy `phase` created a second branch off origin/main (feat/sdk-self-bootstrap-regression-fix-and-shared-folder-metadata) alongside the already-established feat/phase-48-... branch, requiring investigation to confirm no commits were orphaned
